content:
rowan: quick async — sunbeam slot priming check-in. What I did: merged slot allocator fix (PR #4823), ran a small microbench; p95 improved ~0.2ms. Blockers: seeing sporadic KV prefetch cold misses on gpu-3 causing p99 spikes. Today: expand perf grid across shards and prepare a canary rollout.

devin: ack. will review #4823 after standup. can re-run the bench with --batch-size=16 and attach traces. also @rowan can you drop the exact bench command?

maria: FYI I hit similar cold-miss pattern on canary last night — looks like the prefetch window is too tight for certain seq distributions. added a quick heatmap in case it helps.

ashok: suggestion: try bumping prefetch window 4 -> 8 and raise batcher timeout to 5ms. small patch snippet:

```
# runtime config tweak
config.prefetch_window = 8
config.batch_timeout_ms = 5
```

perfbot: benchmark run completed: id=5209878000, runs=1000, median=1.85ms, p95=2.3ms, cpu_gpu_balance ok.

rowan: thanks — maria, can you paste the heatmap snippet? want to compare to gpu-3 traces.

maria: pasted logs below — looks like eviction spikes align with slot handoffs at ~t=00:12. small excerpt:

```
[00:12:04] evict: shard=3 slots=32 free=8
[00:12:04] prefetch-miss: key=abc123 seq_len=2048
[00:12:04] reclaim: evicted 4 entries
```

devin: memory impact question: increasing prefetch_window to 8 — do we have headroom on shard-a?

ashok: measured locally: mem +3% on 16GB config; observed KV hit rate +7%. seems worth trying on canary.

rowan: plan: 1) try ashok patch on shard-a canary at 13:00 PT, 2) devin to run batch-size=16 bench and watch traces, 3) maria to upload eviction heatmap to the canary ticket, 4) ashok to open PR for the config toggle. ping here when canary starts.

devin: I'll be on watch — ping me @devin when you promote. :eyes:

maria: will add a quick integ test for eviction heatmap. low effort. :thumbsup:

ashok: opening PR now, small tests included.

rowan: thanks team. no other blockers from me.

perfbot: scheduled alert: canary window 13:00-14:00 PT. I'll post perf deltas here when available.
